reviews.t: Hands down this is the best brush that I’ve ever owned.
reviews.x: I have very long hair (down to my butt) and one thing that I am not cheap with is making sure that my hair stays healthy. While I was on instagram, I saw a “hair growing influencer” speak about how great this brush was. That’s when I began looking into it.  I am constant testing and trying new products and brushes. I’ve used a lot of brushes during my hair growing journey and this one is amazing. It glides like butter through my hair and feels so good.  Don’t skimp on your hair! Get this brush.

I was having such a problem with little pieces of my hair breaking off while brushing with my old brush so I was looking around for something new. After reading about the benefits of this type of brush I was excited to give it a try. Now using this brush I don’t see any little pieces breaking off and it just feels better on my hair. As for the other reviews here saying it’s missing a piece, it isn’t. It’s an air hole. This brush is totally worth it in my opinion.

I splurged on this for healthy hair and it was like flushing money down the toilet. The customer service is as disappointing as the product. They told me "the rubber collapsed because it wasn't taken good care of." but I always take such good care of everything I buy. It's a faulty product. No refund, no replacement or exchange. All they did was offer a small discount on a future purchase- but why would I trust buying another one after this? I'm so disappointed.

reviews.t: Terrible company. Brush doesn’t last even a year.
reviews.x: Like other people with few stars I have the same issue with the bristles collapsing and not straight anymore. First they said that they would replace the brush. Then they asked me to put their brushes on my Instagram feed. Then they turned back on their offer completely! The brush is 9 months old and the company said that that’s “way too old” and that I also didn’t buy it directly from them in Italy—that they would not do anything for me.

reviews.t: 💜💜💜 Love. I want all of them!!
reviews.x: I 💜💜💜💜 my tek brush.i absolutely love it! I know I said it twice. But the brush  is soft, and doesn’t yank on your hair. I’ve noticed less breakage. Makes my hair soft. And I love the massaging feel it gives. Almost like ASMAR. On your scalp. The more I brush my hair with it, the more softer it gets and shinier.

reviews.t: Love this Italian brush as much as I love Italian food!
reviews.x: Love this brush!! Nice medium size, soft bristles, and cleans really nice. I read that Tek brushes are easy on hair and don’t cause breakage. My mom also has one that she has used for years and love it! I have long fine hair, that most brushes destroy. Wooden brushes also distribute your natural oil throughout, and stimulate the scalp.  I’m looking forward to using this brush for years to come.

I have wanted a wooden brush for a while, but the expense has prevented me from buying one. This one is reasonably priced, but the quality seems really good. I have noticed that my hair has a bit less frizz and static since I've started using this brush. I have long, thick, wavy hair that does go frizzy easily, so this is a huge plus for me. It seems quite gentle on my hair as well.

reviews.t: Quality product, but still created static
reviews.x: Overall the quality of this product is excellent and has held up well since I’ve purchased about three months ago.  My only complaint- I still get a small amount of static from brushing my hair with this brush. One of the reasons for buying a wooden brush was to negate the static effect. It could be that maybe I just have super “dry” hair and need to find a better balanced shampoo/conditioner. Who knows.

I’ve only been using this brush for a week and I already LOVE it. I feel like it’s super gentle and gets through tangles with ease. I was having issues with static in my hair and kept thinking it was my conditioner. Nope. Evidentially it was my brush! Haven’t had any issues since. I also love the way it massages my scalp. Best purchase i’ve Made for my hair!
I saw this brush on holistichabits YouTube Channel and i loved how she explained all the details about the brush. Receiving the item and using it in person confirmed how great it is.

reviews.t: What a difference a good brush makes

I brush my hair when I'm watching tv or reading because ill just focus on slowly and gently doing it for 20 minutes. It kind of feels like a massage! I love the wood and durability

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the brush for being gentle, reducing breakage, and leaving hair healthier and softer.
Many customers say it is worth the higher price and the best brush they have owned.
Several reviewers report the bristles or rubber collapsing and the brush not lasting, often within a year.
Multiple negative reviewers describe poor customer service, including refused replacements and refunds.
Some reviewers note the brush still produces static, contrary to expectations for a wooden brush.
